effect_entries.effect: This move cannot be used unless the user is holding a berry. The user consumes a berry, activates its effects, and raises its defense by 2 stages. This effect works even if Embargo or Magic Room are in effect.
effect_entries.short_effect: User consumes berry and raises its defense by 2 stages.

もっている　きのみを　たべて
ぼうぎょを　ぐーんと　あげる。

지니고 있는 나무열매를 먹고
방어를 크게 올린다.

吃掉攜帶的樹果，
大幅提高自己的防禦。

Le lanceur mange la Baie qu’il tient, ce qui augmente
beaucoup sa Défense.

Der Anwender frisst die Beere, die er trägt,
wodurch seine Verteidigung stark erhöht wird.

El usuario ingiere la baya que lleva equipada para
aumentar mucho su Defensa.

Se chi la usa ha con sé una bacca, la mangia
e la sua Difesa aumenta di molto.

The user eats its held Berry, then sharply raises its
Defense stat.
